title: Embodied fly, stage 1: does antennal drive move the front leg toward the head? (SIMULATED, open loop)
status: registered before any network spike train was turned into muscle activation
seen_before_registration: MaleCNS motor results (fly_motor_readout): under JO-CE drive the front-leg motor pool fires at 5.0 Hz on average (both sides), under sugar 2.4 Hz; no per-type rates were looked at

FlyMimic body, no network: passive rest puts the left claw 1.528 mm from the left antennal pedicel; the shipped motion-capture clip (real fly, 225 frames) spans 1.03-2.01 mm, so it is not antennal grooming

single-muscle checks at full activation: trochanter flexors bring the claw to 0.71-0.95 mm, promotors to about 1.16-1.18 mm, accessory trochanter flexor 1.16 mm, tibia extensor 1.33 mm; trochanter and sterno-tergo-trochanter extensors move it away (1.9-2.1 mm)

design.network: the MaleCNS model of fly_malecns_replication.json (Traced bodies, consensus signs, Shiu constants), no drug, no background

drives.jon_ce: the matched JO-CE set at 150 Hz (left antenna)
drives.sugar: the matched sugar set at 150 Hz (control drive)

design.motor_neurons: MaleCNS motor neurons with subclass fl and somaSide L (the left front leg)
design.rate: each motor neuron's spike train filtered with an exponential kernel, tau 20 ms, giving a rate in Hz
design.activation: per muscle, the mean rate of its motor neurons divided by r_full, clipped to [1e-4, 1]; r_full = 20 Hz primary, 10 and 40 Hz as sensitivity
design.body: FlyMimic (FlyGym commit a63dc91) in MuJoCo 3.16.0, its own timestep (0.1 ms); 0.2 s passive settle at activation 1e-4, then the 1 s activation time course, updated every 1 ms; no sensory feedback (open loop)
design.readout: distance from the left claw (LFTarsus5) to the left antennal pedicel (LPedicel), per trial its minimum over the driven second

S1a_antennal_drive_brings_the_claw_to_th.statement: Under JO-CE drive the claw comes closer to the antenna than under sugar drive or no drive
S1a_antennal_drive_brings_the_claw_to_th.test: median over trials of the minimum claw-antenna distance under JO-CE is at least 0.2 mm below both the sugar and the no-drive medians (r_full 20 Hz)

S1b_it_is_a_movement_toward_the_head.statement: The approach is a movement toward the head, not a shift of the rest posture away from it
S1b_it_is_a_movement_toward_the_head.test: minimum claw-antenna distance under JO-CE below the passive rest (1.528 mm) in at least 6 of 8 trials

S1c_the_activation_scale_does_not_decide.statement: S1a holds at the other two activation scales
S1c_the_activation_scale_does_not_decide.test: S1a's test holds at r_full 10 Hz and at 40 Hz

not_claimed_even_if_all_pass: that the movement is grooming as a fly performs it: the model is open loop, has one muscle-driven leg, no tarsal muscles, and motor neurons firing far below physiological rates
reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail, whichever way it falls; the motor-neuron coverage of the map is reported.
